title: 4 Verses a Godly Man Reads When His Work Feels Pointless
caption:
Some weeks the work feels like nothing. Four verses for the day you want to coast.

Colossians 3:23, Ecclesiastes 9:10, Galatians 6:9, 1 Corinthians 15:58.

Which one do you need this week? Save it for the Tuesday you do.
